scope: Add explicit state/copy constraints only; no change to prior frozen art or gameplay.

button_visual.restart: normal source; focus/hover may use brightness1.06 without hue/saturation change; no new primary color
button_visual.pressed: existing input policy; no repeated action

unfinished_same_attempt.note_zh: 本局未结束，重玩不再扣体力。
unfinished_same_attempt.note_en: No extra energy for an unfinished game.
unfinished_same_attempt.confirm: restart current unfinished attempt once; do not create a new debit

settled_replay_energy_sufficient.confirm: use existing new-attempt flow, verify current energy and debit exactly once

settled_replay_energy_insufficient.note_zh: 体力不足，重玩需要5点体力。
settled_replay_energy_insufficient.note_en: Not enough energy. Replaying requires 5 energy.
settled_replay_energy_insufficient.confirm: do not reset the board, do not debit, do not launch an attempt; route to existing insufficient-energy flow

guards: Choose note from actual attempt status and fresh energy state, never show free-restart note after settlement.
Recheck energy atomically in existing business flow; static UI does not implement transactions.
Cancel is always zero side effects.
This supplemental contract is not permission to rewrite existing game logic.
